root.name: インディ・セミコンダクター

rows.ja: 製造・パッケージの供給元

relations.text: TSMCは、インディ・セミコンダクターの主要な製造委託先(ファウンドリ)の1社に入る
relations.text_en: TSMC is one of indie Semiconductor's primary foundry partners.

source.label: indie Semiconductor 10-K
source.quote: Our primary foundry partners are TSMC, Global Foundries, X-FAB and HHGrace and we may add foundries as our product portfolio evolves.

relations.text: 先端ノードを含む複数のプロセスでTSMCとGlobal Foundriesを製造委託先として使っている
relations.text_en: Uses TSMC and Global Foundries as foundry partners for several process technologies, including advanced nodes

source.label: indie Semiconductor 10-K
source.quote: We use TSMC and Global Foundries as our foundry partners for several process technologies, including advanced nodes.

companies.name: ASEテクノロジー・ホールディング

relations.text: パッケージングはASEやSCKなどに複数委託している
relations.text_en: Multi-sources packaging at ASE, SCK and other suppliers

source.label: indie Semiconductor 10-K
source.quote: We multi-source packaging at ASE, SCK, and other suppliers.

relations.text: Wells Fargo Bank, National Associationと与信枠1,000万ドル、金利SOFR+1.75%のリボルビング融資契約を2024年3月29日に結んだ
relations.text_en: Entered into a revolving line of credit agreement with Wells Fargo Bank, National Association on March 29, 2024, with a credit limit of $10.0 million at SOFR plus 1.75%

source.label: indie Semiconductor 10-K
source.quote: On March 29, 2024, we entered into a revolving line of credit agreement with Wells Fargo Bank, National Association (“Wells Fargo”) with a credit limit of $10.0 million, bearing interest at the Secured Overnight Financing Rate (“SOFR”) plus 1.75%.
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。

relations.text: 制限付き現金は、Wells Fargo Bankとのリボルビング融資契約の条件で維持を義務づけられた現金である
relations.text_en: Restricted cash consists of cash it must maintain under the terms of its Wells Fargo Bank revolving line of credit agreement

source.label: indie Semiconductor 10-K
source.quote: The Company’s restricted cash consists of cash that the Company is contractually obligated to maintain in accordance with the terms of its Wells Fargo Bank revolving line of credit agreement.

companies.name: グローバルファウンドリーズ

relations.text: 車載レーダー向けSoCをGFの22FDXで製造する戦略的協力を発表した
relations.text_en: Announced a strategic collaboration with GF to develop radar SoCs manufactured on its 22FDX platform

source.label: GlobalFoundries の発表
source.quote: indie Semiconductor (Nasdaq: INDI), an automotive solutions innovator, has announced a strategic collaboration with GlobalFoundries (Nasdaq: GFS) (GF) to develop its portfolio of high-performance radar systems-on-chip (SoC).

relations.text: 子会社を通じ、Wuxi indieの持分34.38%をUnited Faithへ売却する資産購入契約を2025年10月27日に結んだ
relations.text_en: Through a subsidiary, entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement on October 27, 2025 to sell its 34.38% equity interest in Wuxi indie Microelectronics to United Faith

source.label: indie Semiconductor Form 8-K
source.quote: On October 27, 2025, indie Semiconductor, Inc., a Delaware corporation (“indie”), through its subsidiary Ay Dee Kay LLC, a California limited liability company (“ADK”), entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement (the “Asset Purchase Agreement”) with United Faith Auto-Engineering Co., Ltd., a publicly-listed company in the People’s Republic of China (“United Faith”), pursuant to which indie has agreed to sell ADK’s entire 34.38% of the outstanding equity interest in Wuxi indie Microelectronics Technology Co., Ltd., a Chinese entity (“Wuxi”) to United Faith (the “Asset Sale”).
source.note: 子会社経由の契約で、完了は承認次第です。
source.note_en: Entered through a subsidiary; closing is subject to approvals.

companies.name: モノリシック・パワー・システムズ

relations.text: インディ・セミコンダクターと競合する

source.label: indie Semiconductor 10-K
source.quote: Our primary competitors are other automotive-focused semiconductor companies, including Infineon, Monolithic Power Systems, NXP, Renesas and ST Microelectronics.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
